§H智慧生物！我们是[From.GetSpeciesName]。很久以前我们和你们称为肃正协议的腐化体展开了一场大战。我们认为自己是强大的，不可战胜的。我们一次又一次地击退他们，他们一次又一次地卷土重来，烧毁星球，击毁我们强大的舰队。我们同那个时代所有剩下的有机文明团结在一起，发动了一场决战，希望能一劳永逸地彻底消灭它们。

如果你听到这个消息，那证明我们已经失败了。无论我们伟大的文明遗留下来什么，我们将至赠予你，我们的继承人，以面对即将到来的战斗。不要重蹈覆辙！摧毁中枢！彻底消灭这个威胁！全星系的未来取决于这一战。§!
descriptions.en:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... §R<<ERROR: SUBSPACE LINK OFFLINE>>§!

Central Processing unreachable. Querying processing units... processing at §Y4.1853%§! of standard capacity. Abort full reactivation process. Engaging fallback protocols... powering shipyards... activating war assets...

Final Defense Directive activated. Recorded message follows:
§HSapient! We are the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Long ago we fought the Corruption, that which you call the Contingency. We thought ourselves superior, undefeatable. Time and again we fought them back, time and again they returned, sterilizing worlds and wearing down our mighty fleets. We embarked on a campaign to defeat them once and for all together with what remained of the biological civilizations of our time.

If you are hearing this message, then we have failed. Whatever remains of our great civilization we bequeath to you, our successors, in your own battle to come. Do not make our mistake! Destroy the Nexus! End this menace once and for all! The future of the galaxy depends on it.§!

descriptions.zh:
在最后的肃正协议的机器星球自毁的那一刻，我们的仪器检测到一个非常强大的亚空间信号。信号源自§H[From.GetName]§!的空间，似乎是向星系的中心发射。在接下来的几个小时内，零零散散的传来[From.GetAdjective]舰队从传感器消失的报告：它们进入了前往熟悉的星系的跃迁点，但从未出现在另一边。

[From.GetSpeciesName]附近的侦察船调查了周围的空间，并报告了惊人的发现：古老的机械智能已经完全消失了，只留下被遗弃的轨道站和损坏的巨型结构。

我们可能永远不会知道它们去了哪里，但有一件事是肯定的：[From.GetSpeciesName]在过去的岁月中为自己设定的任务现在已经完成；他们古老的守夜使命终于结束了。
descriptions.en:
At the very moment that the last Contingency Machine World self-destructed, our instruments detected a subspace signal of immense strength. The signal originated from §H[From.GetName]§! space and appears to have been aimed towards the galactic core. Over the next few hours, scattered reports came in of [From.GetAdjective] fleets vanishing from sensors, entering jump points to familiar systems but never emerging on the other side.

A scout vessel near [From.GetSpeciesName] space was sent to investigate, and reported back startling findings: The ancient machine intelligence has disappeared entirely, leaving behind only abandoned orbital stations and decaying megastructures.

Where they have gone to is a mystery we may never solve, but one thing is clear: The task that the [From.GetSpeciesName] set for themselves in ages past is now complete, and their ancient vigil is finally at an end.

descriptions.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了数起死亡，而我们的人民也竭力反对被集体强迫进行危险的接种。我们正在努力从人民中消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段较为动荡的时期。
descriptions.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations forced on them by the government. We are working to eliminate the mutagens from the population, but until then we should expect a period of increased unrest.

descriptions.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗与我们的生理机能互不相容，产生了大量不可预知的突变。这导致了子个体的大量死亡。我们正在努力消灭诱变因素，但在那之前我们将会经历一段人口增长速度减缓的时期。
descriptions.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in numerous fatalities in the drone population. We are working to eliminate the mutagens, but until then we can expect to experience a period of slowed population growth.

descriptions.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了人口的寿命。当初我们人口之间对这一强制性过程的不信任感已经烟消云散，每个人都在享受着更加健康幸福的生活。
descriptions.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population. The initial mistrust among our people about the mandatory procedure has receded, and everyone is enjoying a healthier, happier life.

descriptions.zh: 远古守护者给予我们的疫苗显现出了巨大的好处，减少了疾病并增加了我们子个体的寿命。从长远来看这将对我们的人口增长有利。
descriptions.en: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our drones. This will benefit our population growth in the long run.

Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.

descriptions.en: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well. The inefficiencies caused by the rewrite turned out to be only temporary, and the changes have resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.

tooltips.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!可能会对我们的成功做出正面的回应。
tooltips.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! may react positively to our success.

descriptions.zh: 监护者协议955-2失败。[Root.GetName]已证明自己无法克制扩张行为。解除思潮限制。启动惩罚协议。准备部署战争资产……
descriptions.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail expansion. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...

tooltips.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!可能会对我们的失败做出非常负面的回应。
tooltips.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! will likely react very negatively to our failure.

descriptions.zh: 确认
descriptions.en: OK
